evaluation_scope: Prospective validation of the unchanged Varlen L1 model. Sixteen input-condition strata include eight complementary long-KV studies; these are measurement strata of the same implementation, not additional kernel families. Every seven-dimensional geometry is unique. No calibration or model change in this plan extension.
execution_order: Two independently shuffled passes, round-robin across 16 equally sized strata; each block of 16 collections includes every stratum. All forecasts frozen before any measurement. Failures continue; no total runtime limit.
measurement_protocol: Two separate profiler collections per input, one kernel launch each, no explicit warmup; no automatic retries; retain all samples and use their median. Resume skips recorded outcomes, including failures.
novelty_rule: 320 distinct seven-dimensional geometries, each assigned one dtype; FP16/BF16 balanced within every stratum. All inputs and S1/S2 pairs exclude previously measured data and the entire prior v3 plan, whether or not it has started.
